youtube.baslik: In tinnitus retraining therapy, why doesn't the sound fully cover tinnitus? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In tinnitus retraining therapy (TRT), the principle of sound therapy is to avoid silence and reduce the contrast between tinnitus and outside sound; the sound generator is usually set at or slightly below the mixing point, so that tinnitus is still heard. Covering tinnitus completely, that is, masking it, is not recommended, because the brain cannot habituate to a signal it does not hear.
